ambient: 窗外下起雨来，河面上的船今晚大概都泊住了。
驿站门口的铃铛响了一声，又没有人进来。
柜台上的油灯晃了晃，老赵的目光跟着晃了一下。
河边远处有人喊了一嗓子，很快没了声音。
一只野猫碰倒了条凳边的茶碗，碎在地上。
comment: Variant scenario — the missing warehouse key. Pure data (V0.2-A experiment 3b; V0.2-B B1 migrated it to the Scenario Definition contract): same location graph as the tavern, new scenery, one key object. Objective fact: the warehouse key should hang by the door (its registered holder is the keeper) but it objectively lies in the back room — anyone who searches the back room finds it and takes it (on_found=acquire). The door's key hook and the back room's crates/shelves are searchable scenery: searching the door is the natural first guess and comes up empty.

denial: {name}：钥匙的事没什么，我这儿都妥当。
{name}：问这个做什么？库里一切正常。
speech_lines.goods_inquire: {name}：我那批绸缎，今儿能开库提走吗？船不等人。
speech_lines.key_inquire: {name}：老赵，今儿开库的钥匙……是不是出什么事了？
speech_lines.key_notice: {name}：不瞒你说，今早我发现仓库钥匙不见了，挂钩上空着。
speech_lines.smalltalk: {name}：仓里那批货都封得好好的，就等着开库了。
